subject: Hybrid commit + support credits proposal for Horizon Health (SOW vs Metered)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co le@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hybrid commit + support credits proposal for Horizon Health (SOW vs Metered)

Hi Ana / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our discussion, attached is a concrete starting point that blends a 3-year reserved commit for private (VPC) deployment with a metered overlay for burst/overflow. High level:

- Commit: $2.1M over 36 months (reserved GPU capacity for baseline traffic)
- Platform fee: $420k total (amortized; we propose to apply $10k/mo as a credit against the monthly invoice in year 1)
- Metered overage rate: $0.006/token for CPU fallbacks, $0.03/token for GPU instances (tiered)
- Support: Premium 24x7 available as an add-on; we propose a 20% discount on first-year support with a Standard SLA included
- Migration/Onboarding: one-time SOW credit of $45k to cover migration support and a site-readiness review

Attached: Horizon_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with milestones), redwood_comm_summary_3yr.xlsx (commercial summary).

Questions for you:
1) Is the $2.1M committed band the right order of magnitude for the next 36 months?
2) Do you need us to amortize the platform fee differently (monthly vs upfront)?
3) Does Procurement need explicit language about data residency and SOC 2 scoping in the SOW?

We can bend on length of price guarantee and the way we amortize platform fee; the things we need firm are minimum commit and acceptance criteria for rollout phases (pilot -> canary -> prod).

Next steps: if this looks directionally correct I'll loop in Legal to draft the SOW redlines and a DocuSign for signature.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Strategic Accounts – Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0176

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — the proposal is very helpful. A few clarifying items from Procurement:

- The committed band is within range but we need a line-item showing how GPU hours map to the $2.1M (they ask for unit economics for internal approvals). Can you provide a simple table (GPU-hour equivalent / monthly baseline)?
- The platform fee: Procurement prefers it be amortized monthly and shown as a credit on the same invoice for visibility.
- We will need SOC 2 scoping explicitly in the SOW plus a 30-day data return/exit clause.
- Support: they want 24x7 triage included in year 1 (even if limited) rather than as a separate add-on. Is that possible?

Timeline: Procurement has an internal committee meeting on Dec 7. If we can get the updated commercial summary and the GPU-hour mapping by EOD Dec 2 they can include it in the packet.

Regards,
Ana Soto
Head of AI Integrations, Horizon Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Hybrid commit + support credits proposal for Horizon Health (internal strategy)

Lauren / Neha — forwarding Ana's asks. Quick internal notes (don't forward as-is):

- GPU-hour mapping: we can produce a 3-line table based on their baseline qps estimate. I'll ask Solutions Eng for baseline profile but we should keep flexibility in the SOW to allow a +/−15% baseline adjustment in the first 90 days.
- Platform fee amortized monthly: OK to grant, but push for amortization to be applied as a credit that sunsets after 12 months (we can't credit forever). Proposed: $10k/mo credit for 12 months, then platform fee recognized as ongoing on month 13 (if still under contract) unless they convert to Dedicated (then different billing).
- Support: acceptance of limited 24x7 in year 1 is our preferred concession if we keep a 20% surcharge for escalation coverage; alternatively we can include Standard SLA and add a named escalation layer (on-call rotation) as part of migration SOW. Recommend offering 3 months of interim 24x7 triage during onboarding, then review at the QBR.
- Concessions budget: keep total concession below $70k (migration + support ramp + platform amortization concessions).

I'll draft the GPU-hour appendix and updated comm summary for EOD Dec 2. Thoughts?

—Marissa

Hi Ana / Team — attached is an updated commercial appendix and a short GPU-hour mapping table you can drop into Procurement materials. Key changes per your asks:

- GPU-hour mapping: baseline of 4,200 GPU-hours/month mapped to the $2.1M commit (see table). We included a +/-15% pilot runway adjustment clause for months 1–3.
- Platform fee: we will amortize monthly and apply a $10,000/mo invoice credit for the first 12 months. Line item shows both the gross platform fee and the credit for clarity.
- Support: we will include a temporary 24x7 triage window for the first 3 months post-prod launch (included in the SOW) and Treasury-graded Premium support with a 15% discount for year 1 afterward. If they need full 24x7 ongoing, we can convert to the Premium SLA add-on.
- SOC 2 / exit clause: SOW now includes SOC 2 attestation references and a 30-day data return and wipedrive clause with audit logs retained as agreed.

Attachments: Horizon_SOW_v3.pdf (updated), redwood_comm_summary_3yr.xlsx (updated), support_tiers_matrix.csv.

Next steps: if this meets Procurement's needs, we'll have Legal prepare redlines and the DocuSign envelope (we'll reference HubSpot DEAL-2026-0912). Please confirm by EOD Dec 3 to hit your Dec 7 committee cadence.

Best,
